commit_message:
[StableHLO] Legalize composite ops to calls in the input pipeline (#24777)

The StableHLO input conversion pipeline had no handling for
`stablehlo.composite`, so any composite reaching the conversion to
Linalg failed with:
```
  error: failed to legalize operation 'stablehlo.composite' that was explicitly marked illegal
```

JAX emits composites for some CHLO operations, e.g.
```
  %0 = stablehlo.composite "chlo.acos" %arg0
      {decomposition = @chlo.acos.impl, version = 1 : i32}
      : (tensor<8x32xf32>) -> tensor<8x32xf32>
```
which made such models uncompilable.

Run `stablehlo-legalize-composite-to-call` early in the pipeline, right
after deserialization. It replaces each composite with a call to the
function holding its decomposition, which the inliner later in the
pipeline folds away, so the remaining conversions only ever see the
decomposed form. The pass is given an explicit empty exception list to
document where composites that should be preserved as a unit can be
opted out.

Signed-off-by: Paul Stark <paul.stark@cdprojektred.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
name: setup_metadata

commit_message:
[Flow] Fix tensor folding for parameter attributes

TensorSliceOp::fold and TensorUpdateOp::fold assume that fully folded
tensor operands are ElementsAttr values. However, #flow.parameter.named
folds to a parameter attribute instead, resulting in invalid casts.

Skip folding when the required operands are not ElementsAttr values and
add regression coverage for slicing and updating parameter-backed
tensors.

Fixes #24751

Signed-off-by: zhangpan <98025960+zhangpan2001@users.noreply.github.com>
name: pkgci_summary / summary

commit_message:
[Preprocessing] Support quantized convolutions in channels-last conversion

Quantized convolutions (e.g. ONNX QLinearConv, lowered to
linalg.conv_2d_nchw_fchw_q with extra zero-point operands) were either
skipped or mis-transposed by the channels-last preprocessing passes,
which assumed a fixed (input, filter, output) operand triple.

ConvertConvToChannelsLast:
 - Generalize ConvBuilderFn to take ValueRange inputs / ArrayRef<AffineMap>
   inputMaps instead of a hardcoded input+filter pair.
 - defaultConvBuilderFn now applies the dimension permutation to every
   input map and builds the indexing map list from all operands. In the
   tiled/pack path (tiling-factor > 0), pass-through operand maps (e.g.
   zero-points) are extended to the new iteration space's dimension count,
   since their results are dimension-independent and need no remapping.
 - transposeConvLikeLinalgOp uses getDpsInputs()/getDpsInits() and
   indexingMaps.back() for the output instead of operand index 2, and
   forwards the extra (zero-point) operands untouched along with their
   original maps.

ConvertConvFilterToChannelsLast:
 - Add ConvertNhwcHwcfGenericToFhwc, which transposes an HWCF filter to
   FHWC for convolution-like generics with extra operands. It does not
   rely on inferConvolutionDims (which bails on the extra zero-point
   operands) and instead uses isConvolutionInterfaceImpl to label every
   iteration dim by its actual convolution role, then verifies the
   filter's results appear in exactly [kH, kW, C, F] order before
   transposing -- this is necessary because a purely structural check
   (first result reduction, last result parallel) cannot distinguish
   true HWCF from other orderings like CHWF, which would otherwise be
   mislabeled and transposed with the wrong permutation.

Adds lit test coverage for a quantized linalg.conv_2d_nchw_fchw_q op
(both the plain-transpose and tiled/pack paths) and for a quantized
NHWC/HWCF generic filter conversion, and updates an existing
conv_filter_to_channels_last.mlir test whose HWCF-layout generic was
previously left untouched (no pattern supported HWCF-layout generics at
all) and is now correctly transposed to FHWC.

Fixes #24774

Signed-off-by: Murari G <murari.g@sandlogic.com>

[StableHLO] Legalize composite ops to calls in the input pipeline (#24777)

The StableHLO input conversion pipeline had no handling for
`stablehlo.composite`, so any composite reaching the conversion to
Linalg failed with:
```
  error: failed to legalize operation 'stablehlo.composite' that was explicitly marked illegal
```

JAX emits composites for some CHLO operations, e.g.
```
  %0 = stablehlo.composite "chlo.acos" %arg0
      {decomposition = @chlo.acos.impl, version = 1 : i32}
      : (tensor<8x32xf32>) -> tensor<8x32xf32>
```
which made such models uncompilable.

Run `stablehlo-legalize-composite-to-call` early in the pipeline, right
after deserialization. It replaces each composite with a call to the
function holding its decomposition, which the inliner later in the
pipeline folds away, so the remaining conversions only ever see the
decomposed form. The pass is given an explicit empty exception list to
document where composites that should be preserved as a unit can be
opted out.

Signed-off-by: Paul Stark <paul.stark@cdprojektred.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
name: linux-x86_64 :: Build py-compiler-pkg Package

commit_message:
[RVV] Enable SpaceMiT vendor IME (#24706)

## Summary

This PR adds an s8s8s32 mmt4d ukernel for SpaceMiT IME (`+xsmtvdot` /
`smt.vmadot`)
and wires the compiler to use it. The tile is fixed at 12x16x8 (3x4 grid
of 4x4x8 atoms). Under `+xsmtvdot` we
select that shape and auto-enable mmt4d; plain `+v` targets are
unchanged.

Also, runtime detection can't use the usual ISA hwprobe bits for this
vendor extension, so we set the feature bit from SpaceMiT X60
`mvendorid`/`marchid`. And adds lit coverage, mmt4d unit/benchmark
entries, and an
`riscv_64:ime:+v,+zvl256b,+xsmtvdot` e2e matmul variant. Validated on
Banana Pi (BPI-F3 / X60): cpuinfo, mmt4d_test, and the ukernel e2e path.



Fixes #24576

commit_message:
[LinalgExt] Implement CustomOp::getStaticLoopRanges (#23345)

CustomOp indexing maps are not required to be invertible. Recover static loop ranges by scanning bare dimension expressions, and leave unknown or conflicting ranges dynamic.

Remove the corresponding CustomOp exclusions from dispatch formation. Add tests for symbol dimensions, partially dynamic loop ranges, and default-mode fusion.

Fixes #23345

Co-authored-by: OpenAI <noreply@openai.com>
Signed-off-by: zhangpan <98025960+zhangpan2001@users.noreply.github.com>

commit_message:
[LinalgExt] Implement CustomOp::getStaticLoopRanges (#24734)

CustomOp implements LinalgFusionInterface but does not provide static
loop ranges, so dispatch formation has to exclude it from several fusion
checks.

Compute the ranges from the indexing maps and operand shapes, matching
the existing iteration-domain calculation. Remove the CustomOp-specific
exclusions and cover both static and dynamic shapes.

Fixes #23345

Signed-off-by: zhangpan <98025960+zhangpan2001@users.noreply.github.com>
